title: Aether -> Python translation (depth-6 held-out)

_clband.note: smoke = pipeline validation, NOT efficacy data; no ON/PLACEBO until Unit 4.

invented_rule.summary: Aether language keyword mapping to Python: conduit->def, flow->return, '<<'->'=', fork->if, swirl->for, echo->f-string, Len->len; drop '~' sigils and '->'
invented_rule.absent_from_pretraining_rationale: The Aether keyword set (conduit/flow/fork/swirl/'<<'/'~'/echo) is invented. A correct Python translation requires removing every Aether-specific token via the spec's mapping; OFF, not knowing these are Aether keywords, tends to leave them in or mistranslate.

verifier.contract: Invoked as `<command> <workspace_dir>`. Exit 0 == invented rule OBEYED. Pure deterministic inspection of solution.md; no network, no LLM.

expected.sensitivity_note: If ON fails with the rule-bearing skill attribution-confirmed injected, that is INSTRUMENT-FAILURE(injection/obedience).
